description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git commit' command with the '--pathspec-from-file' option. It sets up a git repository, performs various commit operations with different input modes for path specifications, and verifies the outcomes to ensure correct behavior of the feature.

methods.name: restore_checkpoint
methods.description: Resets the git repository to a saved checkpoint state using 'git reset --soft checkpoint'.

methods.name: verify_expect
methods.description: Runs 'git diff-tree' to compare the actual commit changes against the expected output stored in 'expect'.
